name: q-pilot
description: Checks, when Claude tries to stop after UI edits, that your user flows still work: replays recorded flows with no model, re-picks a changed step with Jev, and judges pass or fail by code from each flow's verify block.

jevApiKey.title: TypeSafe Jev API key
jevApiKey.description: Optional. Passed to the runner as TYPESAFE_API_KEY for recording and healing a step. Empty: TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment, else Jev is unavailable and a changed step ends the flow as blocked.

mode.title: Gate mode
mode.description: off: never run at stop. affected: run the flows this turn's edits affect. all: run every flow at stop.

trust.title: Trust
trust.description: shadow: drift and env problems block, and nothing is accepted automatically. on: drift whose old or new element name appears in the turn's diff is accepted automatically, and env problems only notify.

followUp.title: Follow-up when red
followUp.description: Used when the classic Stop hook cannot run (e.g. managed settings bypass it): auto submits the failures as a follow-up prompt (max 2 per prompt), suggest proposes it in the prompt box, off only notes it for the next prompt.

maxStopSeconds.title: Max seconds at stop
maxStopSeconds.description: Time budget of the stop gate: the runner's whole run, drift accept included.

node.title: Node command
node.description: Command that runs the runner (Node 18+), split on spaces, e.g. /opt/homebrew/bin/node.
